rectory and passed 421 selected modules plus the supplement. Its unfinished tower compilation was manually
stopped early after a longer historical duration was found. The first run remains recorded as PARTIAL_OR_FAIL.

pleted source/object hash and dependency closure, reused only those 422 successful objects from this session,
and compiled the remaining modules with a 3,600-second per-module limit. The tower and its base-change de-
pendent completed in 1,066.8 and 827.6 seconds, respectively, completing all 423 selected modules. The terminal
then emitted substantive elaboration errors, including a heartbeat-limit diagnostic. After inspection of its log,
that process known to have failed was deliberately terminated. This second run also remains PARTIAL_OR_FAIL. It
was stopped in response to those diagnostics.
The source-revision continuation authenticated the successful source/object closure and invalidated only
the revised failed terminal. Its terminal process was then killed at the environment’s 8 GiB memory limit. The
recorded out-of-memory counters increased. This third replay also remains failed. An unchanged-source contin-
uation with synchronous elaboration, Elab.async=false, also reached the memory limit. That fourth full replay
remains failed. Bounded diagnostics isolated an expensive conversion in the lower-inclusion witness. The fi-
nal continuation authenticated the successful closure and compiled separately reviewed local proof repairs. No
historical Paper XI object was used. Pinned official external Mathlib cache objects were imported. All Mathlib
sources were not rebuilt.
Separate additions and audit history. The terminal required more than the missing explicit PaperXI.Rami
ficationPolyphase import. Its repair also corrects implicit arguments, required standing-hypothesis bindings,
declaration syntax and local proofs. Five private component lemmas factor the comparison proof. The lower-
inclusion witness uses the retained equality in its forward direction. A separate review checks the intended
